events.title: Lodi Wine & Chocolate Weekend
events.description: Lodi Wine & Chocolate turns 30! Celebrate with us at Oak Farm Vineyards during two days of winery tours across Lodi wine country, Saturday, February 6 and Sunday, February 7, 2027, from 11 AM to 4 PM both days.  Your ticket includes a 15 oz stemless wine glass, wine tastings and chocolate treats at participating wineries on your ticketed day or days.  Weekend Pass (Saturday and Sunday): $75 per personSunday Only: $55 per person  Tickets are sold only at lodiwineandchocolate.com and are not available at the door. Ticket sales close at midnight on Thursday, February 4. Must be 21 or older with valid ID.
